# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c25 P46](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0046), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat for a fairy queen part and was described as being pompadoured and frilled within an inch of her life at an Improvers meeting.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v2 c14 P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## Personality

Josie is sharp-tongued, malicious, sulky, and uncharitable, frequently making disagreeable and blunt remarks to or about others. She possesses a pronounced sense of self-importance and vanity, putting on airs whenever possible. Despite her lack of imagination, she exhibits a natural confidence and skill in physical dares like walking board fences, and she is noted as being particularly sharp-tongued.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## History

Josie Pye grew up in Avonlea as a member of the Pye family. At school, she was known for cheating on spelling, making fun of Anne Shirley, and challenging her classmates to dares, including a dangerous dare that resulted in Anne falling from a roof and injuring her ankle. She participated in local events, winning first prize for knitted lace at the exhibition and taking part in school dialogues and concerts. When Miss Stacy formed the Queen's class, Josie joined and eventually passed the entrance examinations, barely scraping through. While attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, she remained notoriously sharp-tongued and critical of others. Unlike her classmates who became teachers, Josie chose to return to Queen's for further education. Later, her family home hosted a farewell party given by the Avonlea Improvement Society, and her family's telephone line was known for eavesdropping on neighbors.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v4 c1 P13](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0013)_
